unlockActions: Add the repository-pinned PM2 dependency when the PM2 adapter task authorizes dependency changes.
Use an isolated writable PM2_HOME for tests.
Build an allowlisted Runtime release entry before lifecycle E2E.
Run lifecycle tests against only the sdar-runtime-* namespace.
Inject TEST_DATABASE_URL from an external secret using the healthy Compose PostgreSQL service.
Use the Node pg client because host PostgreSQL CLI tools are absent.
Create a non-superuser provisioning fixture with only CREATEDB and CREATEROLE for least-privilege E2E.
Keep provisioning and Runtime credentials separate and redact all connection material.

runtime.conflictBehavior: fail with a stable conflict code; never steal an unrelated listener

FakePm2.model: deterministic in-memory process records keyed by allowlisted sdar-runtime-* names
behaviors: idempotent start, stop, restart, delete, and inspect
configurable online, stopped, crashed, missing, timeout, and stable error-code outcomes
reject arbitrary script, cwd, environment key, and non-platform process name
record calls and restart counts without spawning operating-system processes
keep PM2 online separate from live, ready, identity, and Catalog state

FakeProvisioner.model: deterministic in-memory database and role inventory keyed by idempotency key
behaviors: return SecretRef metadata and never plaintext credentials
record create database, create role, grant, and verification order
inject stable already-exists, permission, timeout, conflict, and unavailable outcomes
prove provisioning credentials are not returned as Runtime credentials
preserve failed database state for inspection instead of simulating destructive cleanup

fakeStrategy.certificationLimit: Fake results are Component evidence only and cannot be reported as real PM2, real PostgreSQL provisioning, real-resource qualification, or system Interop certification.

developmentDecision.reason: Ports and Docker PostgreSQL are available for controlled integration; deterministic fakes cover PM2 and provisioning port development until their implementation tasks authorize dependencies.
